verdict.rationale: Anytype ships a first-party local API with a published OpenAPI spec. It covers spaces, objects, properties, types, templates, chats, and file upload, download, and delete, and is complemented by a headless CLI, an official MCP server, and a gRPC extension surface, so much of the core object model is programmable. However, no evidence claims or demonstrates parity with the UI: many UI capabilities have no documented API path, and API v2 is still pre-release. Missing for 10: an explicit UI-parity commitment; documented API coverage for web publishing, collaboration and invites, import/export, queries/views, widgets and sidebar configuration, and sync/network modes; a stable (non-pre-release) v2; independent hands-on corroboration.
